---
title: "Graph Structures Lab"
subtitle: "An interactive tour of graphs and the ways we represent them"
---

- **[Sandbox](sandbox.qmd)** -- a blank canvas with the full toolbar: add and delete nodes and edges, update labels, and select things to see them highlighted.
- **[Neighbours](neighbours.qmd)** -- click a node to see exactly who it's connected to.
- **[Graph Representation](graph-representation.qmd)** -- Two different ways to representgraphs: watch a graph turn into rows of `[key]: [neighbour] [neighbour]` boxes, starting with a single row before seeing the whole list or the same graph as a grid of 0s and 1s, again starting with a single row before the full N x N matrix.
- **[Directed and Weighted Graph](directed-weighted-graph.qmd)** -- Learn how direction and edge weights change graph interpretation.


## Graph Dictionary

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| Node/Vertex | A point in the graph |
| Edge | A connection between two vertices |
| Degree | The number of edges connected to a vertex |
| Path | A sequence of vertices connected by edges (no repeated edges) |
| Connected | Every vertex is reachable from every other vertex |
| Component | A maximal connected subgraph |
| Complete graph K_n | Every vertex is connected to every other; (n(n-1)/2 edges) |
| Planar Graph | Can be drawn in 2D without edge crossings |
| Euler path | Uses every edge exactly once |
| Euler circuit | Euler path that starts and ends at the same vertex |
